summary:
Oksskolten is a self-hosted RSS reader with built-in AI features. The app opens already signed in (auth is bypassed), so I didn't record a sign-in prelude. I saved 5 views, and each one replayed with similarity 1.00:
1. inbox (/inbox): the list of unread articles, with excerpts, source favicons and cover thumbnails, plus the feed sidebar grouped by category with unread counts.
2. article-reader (/go.dev/blog/flight-recorder): one article open in the reader, with its action chips, an AI summary box and the full text. I picked an article that was already liked and read, so replaying it doesn't change any read state.
3. chat-conversation (/chat/c-weekly-digest-1): an existing AI chat thread with message bubbles, formatted replies that link to articles, and the message box.
4. settings-appearance (/settings/appearance): the settings page with its section menu and picture-style options for layout, color mode and color theme. The current appearance was left unchanged.
5. search-palette (/inbox, then click Search and type "postgres"): the search popup over the inbox, with filter chips and matching results.

I left out these screens as near-duplicates or less distinct: the home chat start page at /, the Liked, Read Later, Read and Clips lists (same layout as the inbox), the chat list, and the other settings sections.
